meta.name: make-plan
meta.description: Create a detailed, phased implementation plan with documentation discovery. Use when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation — especially before executing with do.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将需求拆解为分阶段实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在动手前制定详细的分步实施方案。
copy.tagline_en: Break down requirements into phased implementation plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a detailed phased plan before executing a feature or task.

howto.what: Claude会先派子代理查阅项目文档和代码,核实真实存在的API并列出带证据的来源清单;再把任务拆成有先后顺序的阶段计划,每个阶段都注明要复制的示例、验证方式和应避免的做法。
howto.when: 当你要求规划一个新功能、某个任务或分多步的实现,尤其是准备使用 do 动手执行之前,就会触发。

say.text: 帮我规划登录功能的分阶段实施计划,先查一下现有API。
say.note: 它会先做文档勘察再出计划。

say.text: 先别写代码,把新功能的实现规划成分阶段的行动清单。
say.note: 触发 make-plan 生成计划。

say.text: 帮我给这个新功能做规划,每一步都要写清验证方法。
say.note: 会生成带验证清单的详细步骤计划。

howto.what_en: Claude deploys subagents to read docs/code and verify which APIs really exist, producing a sourced list of allowed APIs. Then it creates phased plan: each phase has doc examples to copy, verification, and anti-patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to plan a feature, task, or multi-step implementation, especially right before executing with 'do'.

say_en.text: Plan the login feature implementation in phases, and check existing APIs first.
say_en.note: It will start with documentation discovery.

say_en.text: Don't write code yet; give me a phased plan for this new feature.
Make a phased plan for this feature; each phase must include verification.
